backup: Choose "Both" for the safest backup: Raw restores on this PC, and Packed installs on any PC.
"Packed only" saves disk space. It only removes the temporary Raw folder it made itself, so a Raw backup you made earlier is kept.
Dependencies such as VCLibs or .NET Native are backed up automatically along with the apps that need them.
Close an app before backing it up. Files it has open can make the copy fail.
Running a backup again only redoes what's missing. Tick "Force re-backup" to redo everything.
No Windows SDK? Backups still work as Raw only. Install the "Windows SDK Signing Tools for Desktop Apps" to also make portable .appx files.
Keep the Certs folder with your backup. Restoring on another PC needs it to trust the packages.
Use "Open Summary CSV" to see every backup at a glance. It opens a copy, so editing it can't break anything.
If signing fails, check the Notes column. The tool now shows SignTool's own error message there.
Back up to an external drive or cloud folder before resetting Windows, not to the drive being reset.
restore: Install mode is the most reliable way to restore, especially on a different PC.
Register mode works from the Raw copy and also registers any missing dependencies from the backup first.
Error 0x80073CFB means the same version is already installed. Uninstall it first, then restore.
If an install fails with a trust or certificate error, restore again with sideloading enabled.
Use the "Select:" box and "Confirm" to quickly tick all apps, all not-installed items, or everything missing a backup.
Right-click any row for its files, dependencies, which apps use it, and removal.
The Remove box next to "Open Last Full Report" and the one in the right-click dialog are linked. Changing one changes both.
Run "Verify All Backups…" now and then to catch damaged or incomplete backups before you need them.
Special Actions can rebuild a missing Raw from Packed, or a missing Packed from Raw.
An app built for a newer Windows version (error 0x80080204) can't be installed on an older one. No re-try will fix that.
